# @surfaces-ui/dev-server

Local Connect server for Surfaces UI data sources.

A Connect server for your data: DuckDB (files, Delta, Iceberg, object stores, Postgres), Teradata and DataFusion behind one set of read-only services, with search, pipelines and an agent. Configured by `surfaces.config.ts`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/dev-server
```

## Use

```bash
npx surfaces-dev            # reads surfaces.config.ts; serves http://localhost:5220
npx surfaces-pipelines list # run pipelines headless, for CI or cron
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
